此刻爷孙俩的睡意早已烟消云散，这事儿不彻底弄明白，两人压根没心思上床歇息。

“老祖宗不是说了，这个令牌里什么都有吗？你先试试！”

吴姜深吸一口气，觉得爷爷说的在理，当下按照城隍爷先前教授的方法，集中精神，意念瞬间进入手中的阴差令牌。

不过瞬息之间，一股通透的明悟便顺着指尖涌遍全身，直抵脑海。

在老爷子眼里，只见吴姜紧紧闭着双眼，一动不动，他也不知道什么情况，只能安安静静地在一旁等候。

吴姜第一次意念连接手中的阴差令牌，便相当于令牌认主了，自己在地府的身份、归属，也已了然于心。

原来，吴姜在地府隶属于勾魂司，身份是三等鬼差，老大便是传说中的黑白无常两位大爷。

吴姜沉浸在令牌的空间里，发现里面五花八门的，什么都有，搞的跟某互联网公司的APP似的。什么任务中心、消息中心、兑换中心等等都有，还有一个讲法堂不知道是什么，吴姜想进入其中，提示权限不够。

这些吴姜都没有看，而是第一时间选择了阴差守则，顿时，一长串阴差必须恪守的准则，涌入了吴姜的脑海。

只是第一条内容，就让吴姜傻眼了。

意识收回，吴姜睁开了双眼，老爷子看到他醒了，忙不迭地凑上前询问：“小姜，看到什么了吗？”

吴姜脸上带着几分复杂，小声的说道：“爷爷，按这上面的介绍，身为阴差，不能向任何凡人泄露阴差的身份。要是违反了，不光要扣贡献点，严重的话，还有可能被剥夺阴差身份……”

话说到一半，吴姜便顿住了，祖孙俩四目相对、面面相觑，客厅里瞬间陷入死寂。

老爷子先是愣了愣，眼神有些呆滞，片刻后才反应过来，连忙放缓语气，用自己都不相信的话安慰道：“没事没事，小姜啊，爷爷怎么也不能算一般人吧？咱们可是城隍爷的亲眷，跟地府那就是一家人！”

吴姜也没别的法子，只能暂且把这茬搁在一边，继续梳理脑海中从令牌里接收到的其他知识。

快速梳理了一遍之后，吴姜对于鬼差的身份、职责，也有了一个大致的了解。

At this moment, the sleepiness of the grandfather and grandson has long since disappeared. Unless this matter is fully understood, the two of them have no intention of going to bed to rest.

"Didn't our ancestors say that there is everything in this token? You try it first!"

Wu Jiang took a deep breath and felt that what his grandfather said was reasonable. He followed the method previously taught by the City God, concentrated his mind, and instantly entered the Yin Cha Token in his hand.

But in an instant, a clear understanding surged through his body along his fingertips and reached his mind.

In the old man's eyes, Wu Jiang's eyes were tightly closed and motionless. He didn't know what was going on, so he could only wait quietly.

The first time Wu Jiang connected his mind to the Yin Cha Token in his hand, it was equivalent to recognizing the token's owner. His identity and belonging in the underworld were also clear to him.

It turns out that Wu Jiang is affiliated with the Soul-Causing Division in the underworld, and his status is a third-class ghost agent. The boss is the legendary black and white and impermanent two masters.

Wu Jiang was immersed in the token space and found that there were all kinds of things in it, just like an APP of an Internet company.There are mission centers, message centers, redemption centers, etc., and there is also a lecture hall that I don’t know what it is. Wu Jiang wants to enter it, but it says that he has insufficient permissions.

Wu Jiang didn't look at any of these, but immediately chose the Yin difference code. Suddenly, a long list of rules that Yin difference must abide by poured into Wu Jiang's mind.

Just the first piece of content made Wu Jiang dumbfounded.

After regaining consciousness, Wu Jiang opened his eyes. When the old man saw that he was awake, he hurriedly stepped forward and asked, "Xiao Jiang, did you see anything?"

Wu Jiang had a complicated look on his face and said in a low voice: "Grandpa, according to the introduction above, as a Yin Zai, you cannot reveal the Yin Zai's identity to any mortal. If you violate it, not only will your contribution points be deducted, but in serious cases, you may also be deprived of your Yin Zai status..."

Halfway through his words, Wu Jiang paused. The grandfather and grandson looked at each other, and the living room fell into dead silence.

The old man was stunned at first, his eyes were a little dull, but he reacted after a moment. He quickly slowed down his tone and comforted him with words that he didn't believe: "It's okay, Xiao Jiang. Grandpa can't be considered an ordinary person, right? We are the relatives of the City God, and we are one family with the underworld!"

Wu Jiang had no other choice but to put this issue aside for the time being and continue to sort out other knowledge received from the token in his mind.

After a quick review, Wu Jiang had a general understanding of Gui Cha's identity and responsibilities.
